hypothesis: Column-mode reading with count-anchored ceilings produces zero runaway columns, improves CER on at least two of the three catastrophic pages, and characters where the full-page and column channels agree match gold with at least 0.99 precision on healthy pages.
decision: Keep full-page Gemini as the AncientDoc champion. Count-anchored ceilings are validated as the structural fix for runaway generation: 565 of 565 columns completed with zero truncation and zero failures at 27-34 output tokens each. Column-mode as a page-transcription replacement is rejected: isolated crops lose page context and read more unscored commentary, so column CER is slightly worse on every slice including all three catastrophic pages, and the adjudicator-routed system (0.502729 macro) underperforms plain full-page (0.443086). The dual-channel consensus architecture is directionally validated but does not meet the 0.99 bar under current gold scope: agreement covers 89.06 percent of channel A and its precision against gold is 0.947535 micro on the 12 healthy pages (0.964256 macro, 1.000000 on the cleanest page), versus 0.62-0.75 for either channel alone. Errors now concentrate in the disagreement residue and in gold-scope mismatch, not in generation control.

smoke_evidence.floor_128: first smoke aborted: thought tokens share the output budget
smoke_evidence.floor_1024_low_thinking: 6/22 columns truncated; failing columns differed between runs and every retry succeeded, proving stochastic deliberation spirals (columns-smoke-floor1024.jsonl)
smoke_evidence.resolution: minimal thinking eliminated every truncation at identical quality

paired_cer.interpretation: Isolated column crops lose cross-column context and transcribe interlinear commentary more completely; against main-text-only gold both effects raise CER. The detector-failure page read only its 50 boxed characters in column mode (0.948152 CER), confirming column mode inherits detector recall.

consensus_results.definition: Characters in equal blocks of the minimum-edit alignment between no-space channel A and channel B strings, scored against no-space gold.
consensus_results.finding: Where the two independent channels agree, text is 0.95-1.00 correct on healthy pages and covers 91-97 percent of gold there. Precision failures concentrate on pages whose gold excludes visible commentary or whose diagrams scramble column order, so the remaining gap is evidence scope, not silent model error.

gate_status.catastrophic_improvement: fail: column mode improved 0 of 3 catastrophic pages
gate_status.consensus_target: fail: 0.947535 micro healthy precision against the 0.99 target

evidence.scorer: rapidfuzz 3.14.3 Levenshtein distance and opcodes, installed for scoring and removed afterward

limitations: Development evidence on 28 cases; no qualification suite, no promotion.
Gold on commentary-heavy pages covers only the primary text, so channel and consensus scores there mix model error with scope mismatch.
Column clustering has no register split on these layouts and no diagram awareness; label-bearing diagram pages scramble assembly order.
Consensus alignment is text-level; characters are not yet assigned to individual boxes.
next_permitted_action: Stop replacing the page reader. Build the scope layer instead: classify detected boxes into primary text versus half-width commentary by box size, score the full-page champion against scope-filtered evidence, and send only disagreement spans with their crops to a focused high-thinking adjudication pass. Any gold change follows the gold-correction protocol with a new version.
